items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...His sister married Louis Morrow. ... And I knew him. He used to play mandolin.

ctx.x: I said, you mistaken. I said, not Yala Nunes, not Alcide Nunes. I said, no, he wasn't. He was a white man. He's a white man. I knew his sisters, his brothers, his father. We went to his father's wake and funeral. And his sister married Louis Morrow. Morrow that had the grocery net out of Millenburg. Big, fat Louis Morrow. I know who he was married. His sister was married to him. And I knew him. He used to play mandolin. He was a little bit of thing like Georgie Brunis, about 10, 12 years old. He was, mm-mm. How…
Maybe that's why somebody thought that, because they call him Yellow. He was kind of dark.
